import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class x111C {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader infile = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(infile.readLine());
        int R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        if (R > C) {
            int temp = R;
            R = C;
            C = temp;
        }
        int[][][] dp = new int[C + 1][1 << R][1 << R];
        for (int i = 0; i <= C; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << R); mask++) {
                Arrays.fill(dp[i][mask], 69);
            }
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << R); mask++) {
            dp[0][0][mask] = 0;
        }
        for (int col = 1; col <= C; col++) {
            for (int m1 = 0; m1 < (1 << R); m1++) {
                for (int m2 = 0; m2 < (1 << R); m2++) {
                    for (int m3 = 0; m3 < (1 << R); m3++) {
                        boolean valid = true;
                        for (int bit = 0; bit < R; bit++) {
                            if ((m2 & (1 << bit)) == 0) {
                                if (bit > 0 && (m2 & (1 << (bit - 1))) != 0) continue;
                                if (bit + 1 < R && (m2 & (1 << (bit + 1))) != 0) continue;
                                if ((m1 & (1 << bit)) != 0) continue;
                                if ((m3 & (1 << bit)) != 0) continue;
                                valid = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (valid) {
                            dp[col][m2][m3] = Math.min(dp[col][m2][m3], dp[col - 1][m1][m2] + Integer.bitCount(m1));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int maxFree = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << R); mask++) {
            int used = dp[C][mask][0] + Integer.bitCount(mask);
            maxFree = Math.max(maxFree, R * C - used);
        }
        System.out.println(maxFree);
    }
}
